sections.content:
Now I see clearly:
- Above the left square (rows 34-38, cols 14-28): black at cols 14-18, yellow (background) at cols 19-28. So the left square is blocked from moving up because cols 19-23 are yellow (not black).
- Above the right square (rows 39-43, cols 34-48): orange (background) at cols 34-38, black at cols 39-43. Wait, this shows the right square could move up to rows 39-43, but it's at rows 44-48. Let me check again.
- Right of right square (rows 44-48, cols 44-48): all black. So the right square could move right.
So the maze path is:
- The black cells form a winding corridor
- The squares can only move through black cells
- The left square is blocked from moving up because the path above it is yellow (background)
- The right square is blocked from moving up because... let me check rows 39-43, cols 39-43
Actually, looking at the output:
- Row 39: OOOOOOOOOOBBBBB (cols 34-48)
- This means cols 34-38 are orange (background) and cols 39-43 are black
- So rows 39-43, cols 39-43 are black
- The right square is at rows 44-48, cols 39-43
- Above it (rows 39-43, cols 39-43) is black
- So the right square should be able to move up to rows 39-43
But the right square is at rows 44-48, not rows 39-43. Why?
Oh wait, maybe the right square DID move up to rows 39-43, but then the left square also moved up, and they collided or something?
No, the left square is at rows 39-43, cols 19-23, and the right square is at rows 44-48, cols 39-43. They're at different positions.
Let me re-examine. Maybe the right square got blocked because the path above it narrows. Let me check rows 34-38, cols 39-43:
- Rows 29-38: cols 49-53 are black, cols 19-48 are dots (background)
- So rows 34-38, cols 39-43 are orange (background), not black
- This means the right square can move up to rows 39-43 (where cols 39-43 are black), but not further up
But the right square is at rows 44-48, not rows 39-43. So it only moved up 1 step (5 cells), not 2 steps (10 cells).
Wait, let me recount. The right square started at rows 49-53. After 8 UP actions:
- If each UP moves 5 cells, the square would move 40 cells up, ending at rows 9-13
- But the square is at rows 44-48, which is only 5 cells up from the start
- This means the square only moved 1 UP action before getting blocked
Let me check: rows 44-48, cols 39-43 are black (the square is there). Rows 39-43, cols 39-43 are also black (from the output). So why didn't the square move up to rows 39-43?
Oh, I think I see the issue. When the square moves up, it needs ALL 25 cells (5x5) to be black. Let me check rows 39-43, cols 39-43 more carefully:
- Row 39: cols 39-43 are B (from "OOOOOOOOOOBBBBB", cols 34-38 are O, cols 39-43 are B)
- Row 40: same
- Row 41: same
- Row 42: same
- Row 43: same
So all 25 cells are black. The square should have been able to move there.
Hmm, maybe the square DID move there, but then something else happened. Or maybe I'm misreading the output.
Let me just try moving the squares and see what happens. I'll try LEFT to move the left square left and the right square right.
